**Current build:** the SIGIZI source contract and aggregate monitoring views

:::

## Monitoring scope

The first source-system section is now available on the [SIGIZI monitoring](sigizi.qmd)
page. It covers the five retained clinical sources and the separate deletion
exclusion registry.

::: {.metric-grid}
::: {.metric-card}
### ANC

Antenatal visit volume, canonical encounters, K1–K6 coverage, and source
overlap.
:::

::: {.metric-card}
### INC

Intranatal and delivery recording coverage, with pregnancy and baby-record
denominators kept separate.
:::

::: {.metric-card}
### PNC

Postnatal visit volume, KF1–KF4 coverage, and linkage completeness.
:::
:::

## Data boundary

This site will read approved aggregate monitoring views derived from
`r context$gcp_project`.`r context$upstream_dataset`. Cleaning, matching,
deduplication, canonical pregnancy construction, and outcome definitions remain
authoritative in the `birth-outcome` pipeline.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| BigQuery project | `r context$gcp_project` |
| Upstream dataset | `r context$upstream_dataset` |
| Proposed monitoring dataset | `r context$monitoring_dataset` |
| BigQuery location | `r context$bigquery_location` |
| Publication mode | `r context$publication_mode` |
| Page rendered | `r context$rendered_at` |
